**Analysis:**
The elongated, vein-delimited streaks running parallel along the leaf are highly characteristic of **Bacterial_Leaf_Streak_Black_Chaff**. This disease produces water-soaked to tan/brown lesions that are bounded by leaf veins and run lengthwise, progressing to dark brown/reddish streaks — exactly what is visible here.

- Septoria Leaf Blotch would show more irregular blotches with dark pycnidia
- Tan Spot would show oval lesions with yellow halos
- Rust diseases would show pustule-like uredinia
- Stripe Rust would show yellow/orange pustules in striped patterns

The linear, elongated, reddish-brown vein-limited streaks are the hallmark of bacterial leaf streak.
